equivalences.rationale: The immutable Slam Poetry label and existing Poetry Slam record describe the same international performance-poetry movement and audience-judged format. Founder Marc Kelly Smith uses both names on his own biography, identifies1984workshopping/1986UptownPoetrySlam and international spread, and calls his guide to slam poetry a blueprint for creating slams. Existing catalog description covers that same origin and modern stage delivery, not a narrowly exclusive event. Creator SlamPoetry playlist features modern representatives of this movement; no positive separate genre boundary was found. Do not create a second slot for reversed word order. This proposal does not assert every recorded spoken-word work is an actual competition performance.
